nielsen.name: Match between system and real world

findings.principle: Nielsen #5 & #9 — Error prevention; help users recover
findings.title: Click on “Explode” triggered a JavaScript error
findings.detail: 1 interaction(s) with this element threw a runtime error. The action likely failed silently.
findings.fix: Fix the underlying error and add a user-facing error state with a way to retry.

findings.title: 1 control(s) without an accessible name on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Screen-reader users hear only “button” or “link” with no purpose.
findings.fix: Add visible text, aria-label, or alt text on icon images inside the control.

findings.title: 19 tap/click target(s) smaller than 24×24 px on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Small targets take longer to acquire and cause mis-taps, especially on touch.
findings.fix: Make targets at least 24×24 px (44×44 px for touch); add padding rather than enlarging icons.

findings.principle: Nielsen #5 & #9 — Error prevention; help users recover
findings.title: JavaScript error
findings.detail: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'x')
findings.fix: Fix the error; wrap risky operations so failures show recoverable UI rather than breaking silently.

findings.title: Dead click on “Buy now”
findings.detail: 4 clicks produced no visible change (no DOM update, no navigation) within 1 s. The element is interactive, so feedback is missing or delayed.
findings.fix: Provide immediate visual feedback (active state, spinner, toast) for every action.

findings.title: 36% of all clicks were dead clicks
findings.detail: 4 of 11 clicks produced no response. Users are repeatedly misreading what is clickable.
findings.fix: Audit affordances: clickable things should look clickable, and non-clickable things should not.

findings.title: Field friction: “email”
findings.detail: Focused 3×, 8 deletions vs 3 keystrokes, 0.1 s total. Users are struggling with the expected format or meaning.
findings.fix: Show the expected format up front (example/mask), validate inline as the user types, and accept flexible input.

findings.title: Form started but not submitted (2 fields touched)
findings.detail: On /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html the user interacted with 2 fields but never submitted.
findings.fix: Reduce the number of fields, show progress, save drafts, and make the primary action obvious.

findings.principle: WCAG 3.3.2 Labels · Nielsen #6 Recognition over recall
findings.title: 3 form field(s) without a label on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: 2 rely only on placeholder text, which disappears on input and burdens memory.
findings.fix: Use persistent visible <label>s above fields; keep placeholders for examples only.

findings.principle: Nielsen #1 Visibility of system status · Affordance
findings.title: Rage clicks on “Buy now”
findings.detail: User clicked 3 times in rapid succession on an interactive element (1 burst). This is a strong indicator the user expected something to happen and it didn't — or it was too slow.
findings.fix: Make the response immediate: show a pressed/loading state within 100 ms, disable while processing, and confirm completion.

findings.title: 1 text element(s) fail colour contrast on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Lowest ratio 1.92:1 (needs 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text). 5% of checked text fails.
findings.fix: Darken text or lighten backgrounds to meet WCAG 1.4.3 contrast minimums.

evidence.text: Low contrast text that is hard to read for many users. — 1.92:1

findings.title: 1 image(s) missing alt attribute on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Images without alt are announced by file name or skipped unpredictably.
findings.fix: Add descriptive alt text, or alt="" for purely decorative images.

findings.title: Missing page language on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: <html> has no lang attribute, so assistive tech may mispronounce content.
findings.fix: Add lang="en" (or the correct language) to the <html> element.

findings.title: No <main> landmark on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Screen-reader users cannot jump directly to the main content.
findings.fix: Wrap primary content in <main>; add a “Skip to content” link.

findings.principle: Hick's Law · Nielsen #6 Recognition rather than recall
findings.title: Hesitation over “Explode”
findings.detail: User hovered for 2.8 s without acting — a sign of uncertainty about what this control does or what will happen.
findings.fix: Clarify the label, add helper text or a preview of the outcome; reduce ambiguity between similar options.

findings.title: Navigation with 12 items on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Decision time grows with the number of choices. Long flat menus are hard to scan and remember.
findings.fix: Group into 5–9 top-level categories; move secondary items into sub-menus or a footer.

findings.title: 1 vague link label(s) like “click here” / “read more” on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Links should describe their destination out of context.
findings.fix: Rewrite link text to say where it goes (e.g. “Read the pricing guide”).

findings.title: 13 links with href="#" or javascript: on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Links that are really buttons confuse assistive tech and break middle-click/new-tab.
findings.fix: Use <button> for actions and <a href> for navigation.

findings.principle: Nielsen #5 & #9 — Error prevention; help users recover
findings.title: 1 console error(s)
findings.detail: Failed to load resource: net::ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
findings.fix: Investigate console errors — they often signal broken features users silently hit.

findings.principle: Nielsen #5 & #9 — Error prevention; help users recover
findings.title: 2 asset(s) failed to load
findings.detail: net::ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND file:///Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/nope.png
findings.fix: Fix broken images/scripts/styles; missing assets degrade perceived quality.

findings.title: No ARIA live regions for status messages on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Success/error messages may not be announced to screen-reader users.
findings.fix: Announce async results via role="status" / role="alert".

findings.title: Form fields don't use autocomplete on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Browsers cannot autofill, forcing users to retype known data.
findings.fix: Add autocomplete tokens (name, email, tel, address-line1…).

findings.title: No H1 heading on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Users and assistive tech rely on a main heading to confirm where they are.
findings.fix: Add a single, descriptive <h1> that names the page.

findings.title: Heading levels skipped 1× on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Skipped levels (e.g. H2 → H4) break the document outline.
findings.fix: Nest headings sequentially; style with CSS instead of picking levels by size.

findings.title: 1 text element(s) below 12 px on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Very small text is hard to read, especially on mobile and for older users.
findings.fix: Use ≥ 16 px for body text and ≥ 12 px for captions.

evidence.text: Tiny legal text everybody ignores anyway okay. (10px)

findings.title: No responsive viewport meta tag on /Users/pawan.prajapati/Claude/ux-analytics/test/fixture.html
findings.detail: Mobile browsers will render the desktop layout zoomed out.
findings.fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">.
